name: Oh No Teacher! (Cheating Game)
desc:
Your exam starts NOW... and you did NOT study! 📚😬

Welcome to Oh No Teacher! – the sneakiest classroom on Roblox. Peek at answers, snap secret photos with your phone, toss paper balls and keep one eye on the Teacher. Get caught and it's back to the menu!

🎒 HOW TO PLAY
• Grab a seat, vote a topic and start the exam
• Cheat smart: the Teacher is always patrolling and your suspicion keeps rising
• Survive until the end and score the best grade you can

🔥 CHAOS IN CLASS
Surprise events keep every exam wild: phone calls, power outages, thunderstorms, fire alarms, broken lamps and more. Will the chaos save you... or get you caught?

🎁 REWARDS
Earn coins, diamonds and hearts. Claim daily rewards, finish quests and unlock outfits, pens and gadgets in the Wardrobe and Shop.

👍 Having fun? Like the game, join our group Horiba Studios for a free gift and stay tuned for updates!
